in_marathi.name: Ekaparnika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekaparnika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ekaparnika refers to a one-wheeled vehicle. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the god Vishnu, who rides a divine chariot with one wheel. The name symbolizes stability, strength, and divine protection.
